description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

description.zh: 查询结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ* format. The time must be in UTC.

>  The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
- **zh**：简体中文（默认语言）。
- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language. Valid values:

*   **zh**: simplified Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

description.zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~143074~~)接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ* format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-controller-detection --db-cluster-id amv-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2021-05-03T15:00Z --end-time 2024-06-23T02:21Z --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
